image_description: A close-up shot of several green, elongated vegetables inside a clear glass bowl. The vegetables have a distinct longitudinal ribbed or fluted texture, resembling Armenian cucumbers or snake melons, rather than the smooth skin of standard slicing cucumbers. One vegetable on the right is cut, revealing pale flesh and a central seed cavity. There is a faint, semi-transparent watermark text '100' visible in the center.
